_about: How Sick Of It's enemy art work folders (SickOfItGameEnemies/Generated/<id>/, Tools/Art/art.mjs) map to the Hawkes Gen library (hawkesgen/docs/library.md): each folder is an enemy entity, poses and clips are slots, _takes are takes. art.mjs syncs both ways on every run; node C:/Projects/hawkesgen/bin/hawkesgen-folders.mjs status|import|export hawkes.library.json [--only imp].
